meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布前自动审查代码变更，确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在npm发布前需要多维度自动化代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: Claude会先找出所有自上次npm发布以来的未发布代码变更，把这些变更分组后，最多派10个“ultrabrain”代理逐组做深度检查，同时用5个代理做整体复查，最后让一个总代理汇总，输出发布是否安全、版本号建议和变更日志。
howto.when: 只在你说“pre-publish review”、“review before publish”、“ready to publish?”等，明确要求发布前审查时触发；普通发布请求不会触发。

say.text: 帮我对所有未发布的改动做一次发布前审查。
我准备发 npm 包了，先做预发布审查。
say.note: 触发三层代理全面审查。

say.text: pre-publish review，这次改动有没有破坏性变更？

howto.what_en: Claude detects all unpublished changes since the last npm release, groups them, and spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for per-group deep analysis, plus 5 agents via /review-work and 1 oracle for release synthesis, final output includes readiness verdict, version bump, changelog draft.
howto.when_en: Only triggers when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review (e.g., 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'ready to publish?'). A plain publish/release request does not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review on all unpublished changes.
I'm about to publish to npm. Do a pre-publish review first.
Pre-publish review — any breaking changes in this diff?
